_about: Picture presets (scripts/core/quality.gd), picked in the in-camp menu and kept per PC. low is for the weakest PC (a Ryzen 7 5825U laptop with built-in Radeon graphics; docs/PLAN.md 'Performance target'): the 3D view drawn smaller and upscaled with FSR, FXAA, no ambient occlusion or glow, one sun shadow at a shorter distance. split_render_scale is used for both halves while the couch screen is split, since that draws the world twice.
